def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])

    # Horizontal layout: a short upper panel and a long lower panel.
    if all(g[0][0] == g[0][-1] for _ in [0]) and len({g[r][0] for r in range(h)}) > 2:
        split = next(r for r in range(1, h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1 and g[r][0] == g[0][0])
        short_bg = g[1][1]
        long_bg = g[split + 1][0]
        top_sources = [r for r in range(split) if any(x != short_bg and x != g[0][0] for x in g[r])]
        bottom_sources = [r for r in range(split + 1, h) if any(x != long_bg for x in g[r])]
        a, b = top_sources[0], bottom_sources[0]
        for c in range(w):
            x, y = g[a][c], g[b][c]
            x_mark = x not in (short_bg, g[0][0])
            y_mark = y != long_bg
            if x_mark and y_mark and x == y:
                g[a][c], g[b][c] = short_bg, long_bg
                g[split + 1][c] = x
            elif y_mark:
                g[b][c] = long_bg
                g[h - 1][c] = y
        return g

    # Vertical layout: equivalent operation with the panels side by side.
    split = next(c for c in range(1, w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][c] == 5)
    left_bg = g[1][1]
    right_bg = g[1][split + 1]
    left_sources = [c for c in range(split) if any(g[r][c] not in (left_bg, 5) for r in range(h))]
    right_sources = [c for c in range(split + 1, w) if any(g[r][c] != right_bg for r in range(h))]
    a, b = left_sources[0], right_sources[0]
    for r in range(h):
        x, y = g[r][a], g[r][b]
        x_mark = x not in (left_bg, 5)
        y_mark = y != right_bg
        if x_mark and y_mark and x == y:
            g[r][a], g[r][b] = left_bg, right_bg
            g[r][split] = x
        elif y_mark:
            g[r][b] = right_bg
            g[r][w - 1] = y
    return g

def transform(grid):

    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])

    # Locate the horizontal separator, if present.
    horizontal = None
    for r in range(1, h):
        if len(set(g[r])) == 1 and g[r][0] == g[0][0]:
            horizontal = r
            break

    if horizontal is not None:
        sep = horizontal
        sep_color = g[sep][0]
        short_bg = next(x for x in g[1] if x != sep_color)
        long_bg = g[sep + 1][0]
        a = next(r for r in range(sep) if any(x not in (short_bg, sep_color) for x in g[r]))
        b = next(r for r in range(sep + 1, h) if any(x != long_bg for x in g[r]))
        for c in range(w):
            x, y = g[a][c], g[b][c]
            if x not in (short_bg, sep_color):
                g[sep + 1][c] = x
            if y != long_bg:
                g[b][c] = long_bg
                if y != x:
                    g[h - 1][c] = y
        return g

    # Vertical separator, with the short panel on the left.
    sep_color = g[0][0]
    sep = next(c for c in range(1, w) if all(g[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h)))
    left_bg = next(x for x in g[1][:sep] if x != sep_color)
    right_bg = g[1][sep + 1]
    a = next(c for c in range(sep) if any(g[r][c] not in (left_bg, sep_color) for r in range(h)))
    b = next(c for c in range(sep + 1, w) if any(g[r][c] != right_bg for r in range(h)))
    for r in range(h):
        x, y = g[r][a], g[r][b]
        if x not in (left_bg, sep_color):
            g[r][sep + 1] = x
        if y != right_bg:
            g[r][b] = right_bg
            if y != x:
                g[r][w - 1] = y
    return g
